parameters.query:
SELECT app.setting('shop_base_url') #>> '{}' AS base,
       app.order_access_for_job((p->>'job_id')::uuid, nullif(p->>'order_id', '')::bigint) AS access FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x

SELECT CASE WHEN (p->>'allowed')::boolean THEN jsonb_build_object('linked', true, 'already', true)
              WHEN p->>'phone' IS NULL OR p->>'phone' = '' THEN jsonb_build_object('linked', false)
              ELSE app.link_order_if_phone_matches((p->>'job_id')::uuid, (p->>'order_id')::bigint, p->>'phone') END AS link
       FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ allowed: Boolean($('Load Shop').first().json.access && $('Load Shop').first().json.access.allowed), job_id: $('Woo Tool Request').first().json.job_id, order_id: $('Woo Tool Request').first().json.args.order_id, phone: ($json.id === $('Woo Tool Request').first().json.args.order_id && $json.billing) ? $json.billing.phone : null }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT app.propose_order_operation((p->>'job_id')::uuid, o->>'operation_id', o->>'type', (o->>'order_id')::bigint, o->'payload', o->'quote') AS result
       FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x, LATERAL (SELECT p->'operation' AS o) y
